Title: [Mode] Modular (ver3.0.0)
Content: Objective Customize your own design by simply combining and modifying Pattern Blocks. Location Main Menu Change the mode at the top-right corner Modular Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Change the mode at the top-right corner Modular Block Editor window is now being appeared.

Title: ANIMATION MODE: Pin on/off Animation
Content: Save pin status (active, deactive) by frame. (Ver. MD 7) Objective Save or delete Pin animation key. Location Animation Mode Animation Editor Operation Creating Pin animation key Select a pattern and pin where Pin animation will be applied. Navigate to the menu indicated in Location. Set the status of Pin animation key (Activate / Deactivate) Move Playhead to the frame want to apply Pin animation key and right click. Select Add key on popup menu, Pin animation status (Activate / Deactivate) will be saved to the Pin animation key. When Pin animation key is set, the Pin animation status will be applied from the Pin animation key to next key. When Pin animation key is set, if next Pin animation key is not exist, Pin status will be applied from saved Pin animation key to the last frame. Pin status will be applied, when recording animation. Checking saved Pin animation key status Check Pin animation key status, after setting Pin animation key. From Location, select a Pin where Pin animation key is applied on 3D window. Pin animation status will be displayed on time line. By dragging Playhead, check Pin animation status for each key. Deleting Pin animation key Select a pin. Pin animation key which applied to the pin will be displayed on Location. Select a key and right click. Delete selected key by clicking delete key on popup menu. Available to delete multiple keys by Area select. Move Playhead to the start point of desired area and click the end of the area while pressing 'Shift' key. Delete all key of selected area by right click on selected area&gt select Delete Key on popup menu.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Number of Topstitch Line Setting
Content: Objective Set how many lines of Topstitches there are for a single style. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Number of Lines Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Number of Lines Enter the number of lines as desired. The Number of Lines is now being adjusted and applied. Note : Distance of Number of Lines It is possible to adjust the distance between the lines.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Face Setting
Content: Objective Select the face of Topstitch. Location Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Face Explanation Topstitch is only set for the front of the Fabric. Topstitch is only set for the back of the Fabric. Topstitch is set for the both sides of the Fabric. Note: Topstitch placed on the back of the Fabric do not appear in the 2D window (ver4.2.0).

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Apply Normal Map to Topstitch
Content: Objective Apply Normal Maps to Topstitches for more realistic visualization. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Topstitch Texture Normal Map Operation Topstitch Normal Map Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Topstitch Texture Normal Map The intensity value range of -10 to 10 can be applied automatically as entered. The higher the value, the bumpier expression of top-stitches, the less the value, the less bumpier expression of top-stitches. Apply Topstitch Normal Map Image Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Property Editor Topstitch Texture Normal Map Click on the Search button. Select and load desired texture image file. The selected image is now being applied. Note: Applying method for Topstitch Normal Map is the same as Fabric Texture Normal Map.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Apply Topstitch Texture
Content: Objective Change texture type for Topstitch(es). Note : Texture can only be applied when the type is selected for Texture in the Property Editor. Location Property Editor Texture Search Operation Object Browser Select a Topstitch to add texture image. The selected Topstitch is now being highlighted. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor Texture Search The Open File window appears. Select and open desired texture image file. The selected image is now being applied to the selected Topstitch. Note : Not like fabrics, texture image file cannot be applied by Drag &amp Drop for Topstitch.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Multiple Layer Setting (ver4.0.0 and Below)
Content: Objective Create various different types of Topstitches up to five at a time. Use this function to express top-stitch effects such as multi-colored Overlock. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch (Click Topstitch Style) Property Editor Material + Tab Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch (Click Topstitch Style) Property Editor Material + Tab Click on the check box and set it On. Topstitches are now being created as set.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Offset
Content: Objective Adjust the interval between Topstitches on Internal Lines or Pattern outlines. Location Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Offset Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Topstitch Property Editor Offset Adjust the interval. The value is now being adjusted and applied.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Topstitch Style Preset
Content: Objective Utilize the provided Topstitch presets to quickly visualize a variety of Topstitch styles. Location Property Editor Stitch Preset Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Stitch Preset Based on the chart below, select the desired preset. The selected Topstitch changes based on the choice. Custom Use the Custom preset to input the desired values for the Topstitch style. Bartack Buttonhole Single Overlock Pickstitch Zigzag Note: If any individual setting is changed after a provided preset is selected, the Preset automatically changes to Custom. You can select either Texture or OBJ from the Type menu in the Property Editor. (Ver. 11)

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Rename Topstitch
Content: Objective Rename Topstitches. Location Property Editor Rename Operation Object Browser Select a Topstitch style to rename. Its properties appear in the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Rename The name is now being changed and applied.

Title: TOPSTITCH STYLE PROPERTIES: Open/Save Topstitch Item
Content: Objective Save frequently used Topstitch styles in *.sst file format and open to use them in other projects. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch (Click Topstitch Style) Property Editor Save Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch (Click Topstitch Style) Property Editor Save The selected Topstitch item is saved in .sst file format. To open the saved Topstitch file, click the Open button next to Save.

Title: Delete Topstitch Style
Content: Objective Delete unnecessary Topstitch styles. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch Style Delete Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Topstitch Style Delete The selected Topstitch style is now being deleted. Note: It is also possible to delete by pressing the Delete key on the keyboard. A Topstitch style can only be deleted when it is not applied on a Topstitch by clicking the Delete button.

Title: Reset Topstitch Style Property
Content: Objective Reset Topstitch style properties to default values (ver2.5.0). Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Right-Click Topstitch Style Pop-Up Menu Reset Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Right-Click Topstitch Style Pop-Up Menu Reset The Topstitch style properties are now being reset back to default value.

Title: Copy Topstitch Style
Content: Objective Copy and modify an existing Topstitch style in order to change its properties. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Copy Operation Object Browser Select a Topstitch style to copy Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Copy A new Topstitch style with the same properties of the selected Topstitch style is now being copied.

Title: Apply Topstitch Style
Content: Objective Apply Topstitch styles to selected Topstitch(es). Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab Operation Select and Apply Another Topstitch Style Select Topstitch(es). Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Assign The style is now being applied to the selected Topstitch. Select and Apply a New Topstitch Style Select Topstitch(es). Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab Assign to New Fabric Topstitch Pop-up Menu (Right-click) Assign to New Topstitch A new Topstitch style is now being added to the Topstitch tab and applied to the selected Topstitch at the same time. .

Title: Create Additional Topstitch Style
Content: Objective Create a new Topstitch style. Location Object Browser Topstitch Tab +Add Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Object Browser Topstitch Tab +Add A new item named Topstitch_1 is now being added with the same property of Default_Topstitch. Note: Additional items are added with names of Topstitch_1,2,3. If there are multiple Topstitch styles in the Topstitch tab when creating a Topstitch on a Pattern, click on the desired Topstitch style and create. To create an additional Topstitch style with existing *.sst file, navigate to the Library Hardware and Trims Topstitch and drag and drop the desired Topstitch style to the Topstitch tab. Or, find the Topstitch file in the File Broswer window and drag and drop.

Title: Topstitch List Window
Content: Objective It is possible to create, copy, apply and set a style in Topstitch list window. Without any extra setting, Default_Topstitch is applied as default. Once the Default_Topstitch style is modified, it lasts until rerun of the program and it cannot be deleted.

Title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Topstitch Corner Type
Content: Objective Set Topstitch corner type to extend the stitch more smoothly at corners. Note: If stitch type is Overlock, set the corner type to Curved for smoother extension. Location Topstitch Property Editor Curved/Right Angled On / Off Operation Curved Corner Select a Topstitch with Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor Curved On The selected Topstitch is now being curved and smoothly extended. Right Angled Corner Select a Topstitch with Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Topstitch Property Editor Right Angled On The selected topstitch is now being curved at a right angle.

Title: TOPSTITCH PROPERTIES: Flip Topstitch
Content: Objective Use the Flip function to set a Topstitch on an Internal Shape/Line in a different direction (inside and outside). When setting the Topstitch on the Pattern's cutting line, the Topstitches always appear on the inside of a Garment and the Flip function gets deactivated. Location Property Editor Placement Flip Operation Select a Topstitch with Edit Topstitch tool in the 2D window for changing its properties. Topstitch properties appear on the Property Editor. Follow the indicated guideline below: Property Editor Placement Flip The Topstitch direction will now be changed.

Title: Edit Topstitch
Content: Objective Relocate or adjust length of Topstitches. Location Main Menu Materials Topstitch Edit Topstitch 2D Toolbar Edit Topstitch Operation Relocate Topstitch Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Topstitch Edit Topstitch 2D Toolbar Edit Topstitch Click on a topstitch to change its location. The selected Topstitch is being highlighted. Drag to a desired location. Adjust Topstitch Length Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Materials Topstitch Edit Topstitch 2D Toolbar Edit Topstitch Click and drag one of the two end points of a Topstitch to adjust its length. The selected Topstitch is now being adjusted.

Title: Activate/Deactivate Sewing Lines
Content: Objective Activate or deactivate Sewing Lines as needed. Use this function when Sewing Lines should be applied after the garment is draped, such as the back slits for a men's jacket. Location 2D/3D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) Deactivate/Activate Sewing (Selected) Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D/3D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) Deactivate/Activate Sewing (Selected) Deactivated Sewing Lines appear in white in the 2D and the 3D window.

Title: Add Point to Pattern on Start/End
Content: Objective Add point to Pattern outline on start or end point of a Sewing line. Location Main Menu Sewing Edit Sewing 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Edit Sewing 2D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right click on the Sewing Line. The right click pop-up menu appears. At your need, add point to Pattern outline on either the start or the end point of the selected Sewing Line. The point is added respective to the chosen option. Note: The point is added to the Pattern outline where the selected Sewing Line is placed on. The same procedure can be repeated to add a point to the pattern outline where the other half of the sewing line is placed

Title: Check Sewing Length
Content: Objective Check significant difference in Sewing Line lengths. You can check unintended Sewing Line length difference made during the garment making process. Location Main Menu Sewing Check Sewing Length 2D Toolbar Check Sewing Length Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing Check Sewing Length 2D Toolbar Check Sewing Length The Sewing Lines with length difference greater than 5mm are bolded and highlighted in red.

Title: Reverse Sewing
Content: Objective Reverse Directional Notches of Sewing Lines. Location 2D/3D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) Reverse Sewing (Ctrl + B) Operation Select the Sewing Lines to be reversed. Follow the indicated guideline below: 2D/3D Toolbar Edit Sewing Right Click Pop-Up Menu (on Sewing Line) Reverse Sewing (Ctrl + B) The Sewing Lines' Directional Notches are reversed.

Title: M:N Free Sewing (2D)
Content: Objective Freely establish Sewing Lines on Pattern outlines and Internal Shapes/Lines to sew multiple Patterns (M) to multiple Patterns (N) at once. Location Main Menu Sewing M:N Free Sewing 2D Toolbar M:N Free Sewing Note: Hold down the Free Sewing tool for a while to access the M:N Free Sewing Tool. Operation Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Sewing M:N Free Sewing 2D Toolbar M:N Free Sewing Establish Free Sewing Lines on multiple Patterns, which are considered as M Patterns. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete. The Sewing Lines appear in neon color. While being mindful of Directional Notches, establish Sewing Lines on Patterns which are sewn to M Patterns. Hit the Enter key on the keyboard to complete M:N Sewing Lines. All Sewing Lines no longer appear in neon color. Note: While establishing the Sewing Lines, hit the Delete key on the keyboard to cancel the last action or hit the Esc key on the keyboard to cancel all actions. While establishing M:N sewing lines, if you click on an inappropriate segment, the segment appears in red and the Sewing Line cannot be applied. The difference in lengths between the first and second half seams appears in blue next to the mouse cursor. When the difference is greater than 1 inch, it turns red to alert the user.

Title: Show 3D Garment Window Size
Content: Objective Check 3D Garment window size in pixel. Location Main Menu Display Environment Show 3D Garment Window Size (F9) Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Environment Show 3D Garment Window Size (F9) The result value of 3D Garment Window Size appears in pixel at the right-hand side and the bottom of the window. 2. Follow the indicated guideline again to turn it off: Main Menu Display Environment Show 3D Garment Window Size (F9)

Title: Show Camera
Content: Objective Display FBX imported Cameras on the 3D window. Location Main Menu Display Show Camera Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Environment Show Camera The Camera is now being displayed in the 3D window.

Title: Ground Setting
Content: Objective Set Ground Status and Height of the 3D window. Location Ground Collision Setting Main Menu Preferences Simulation Properties Ground Collision On/Off Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) Simulation Properties Ground Collision On/Off Ground Height Setting Main Menu Preferences Simulation Properties Ground Height Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) Simulation Properties Ground Height Operation Ground Collision Setting 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Preferences Simulation Properties Ground Collision On/Off Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) Simulation Properties Ground Collision On/Off If Collision is Off, the ground vanishes and patterns endlessly fall during simulation. Ground Height Setting 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Preferences Simulation Properties Ground Height Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) Simulation Properties Ground Height 2. Enter desired Ground Height.

Title: Show 3D Shadow
Content: Objective Show or hide 3D shadow of the avatars. Location Main Menu Display Environment Show 3D Shadow Right-click Pop-up Menu (3D window) Show 3D Shadow Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: Main Menu Display Environment Show 3D Shadow Show or hide 3D shadow. Note: For Marvelous Designer Viewer: Main Menu Display Environment Show 3D Shadow'.

Title: Unified Gizmo
Content: Objective Use an unified Gizmo to select, rotate and move elements. Location 3D Toolbar Select/Move Click Pattern Operation 1. Follow the indicated guideline below: 3D Toolbar Select/Move Click Pattern Once a pattern is selected (clicked), the Unified Gizmo appears. Note: Unified Gizmo can be set up at Preference. Main Menu Settings User Settings 3D Gizmo Unified Gizmo Note: Gizmos for Avatars appear when X-ray Joint Points (Shift+X) is on or in OBJ format file.
